recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up an externally hosted heartbeat monitor such as Healthchecks.io, pinged by a small wrapper around `nightly-sync`, so the user gets an alert when the job fails or doesn't run; central logs on the NAS are deferred until needed for troubleshooting.
note: The reply makes one hosted heartbeat alert the only setup for now and defers or rejects Docker and central logging, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
